I'm taking a break. I've been working
all day.

rows.label: tlk44500188_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I'd like to retire, but then I
couldn't afford to eat.

rows.label: tlk44500188_01_msg0003
rows.name:
There's nothing to be done
about it as long as this
country's closed off...

rows.label: tlk44500188_01_msg0004
rows.name:
It's just like me... only growing
older...
